title: Matter waves at equal speed
hints: Wavelength varies inversely with mass at fixed speed.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: $\lambda=h/(mv)$. At fixed speed the smaller electron mass gives the larger wavelength.
statement:
An electron and a proton move at the same nonrelativistic speed. Which has the longer de Broglie wavelength?

[_]{a}

explanations: Its momentum is smaller at the same speed.
Its larger mass makes its wavelength shorter.
They have equal speed, but different momentum.
